# codeowners-gen

> Suggest a CODEOWNERS file from git log numstat output, weighting authors by changed lines per directory, with a handle map and deterministic output Python package `trysac-codeowners-gen`, import name `codeowners_gen`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
